items.summary: dlog-to-tfnp's membership test (g ≠ 1, h^p = 1) does not certify h ∈ ⟨g⟩ unless the order-p subgroup is unique
items.proposed_action: In the Statement of content/Reductions/dlog-to-tfnp.md replace '(for prime order $p$: $g \neq 1$ and $h^p = 1$)' with '(for example, when $p$ is prime and the ambient group has a unique subgroup of order $p$: $g \neq 1$, $g^p = 1$ and $h^p = 1$)'.
items.rationale: In a group with full p-torsion such as Z_p × Z_p, h^p = 1 does not imply h ∈ ⟨g⟩, and g^p = 1 is also needed for g to have order p. The test is sound only when the order-p subgroup is unique (a subgroup of a cyclic group such as Z_q^*, or a curve group whose cofactor is coprime to p). The b09 rewriter flagged this and the verifier kept the flag.
